english_draft: AMD reported Q2 2026 results on August 4, 2026. Revenue was $11.536B, up 50% year over year and 13% sequentially. GAAP gross margin was 54%, and non-GAAP gross margin was 56%. GAAP operating income was $1.990B, and non-GAAP operating income was $3.094B. GAAP net income was $2.297B, or $1.38 per diluted share. Non-GAAP net income was $2.760B, or $1.66 per diluted share. Data Center revenue was $6.7B, up 107%, and represented about 58% of total revenue. Client and Gaming revenue was $3.8B, up 6%. Within that, Client was $3.1B, up 23%, and Gaming was $779M, down 31%. Embedded revenue was $977M, up 19%. The year-ago quarter included an $800M inventory and related charge from U.S. export controls on Instinct MI308, so year-over-year margin comparisons have a low-base effect. There is no same-period Preview for this quarter. The release did not provide analyst consensus or a Q2 guidance comparison. Q3 2026 guidance is revenue of about $13B, plus or minus $300M, and non-GAAP gross margin of about 56%. The company expects Data Center sales to accelerate in the second half of 2026. The next-quarter watch points are Data Center mix, gross margin stability, Gaming recovery, Embedded growth, and financial disclosure of new AI partnerships. The release did not include a cash flow statement.
